reviews.text:
If I could give Dr. Alexander Martinez and his entire team more than five stars, I absolutely would.

I have known and trusted Dr. Martinez with my pets for about 10 years, and that alone says a lot about the kind of veterinarian he is. About seven years ago, he performed surgeries on a Chihuahua I had, and for many years now he has been taking care of my dog, Coco.

And believe me, Coco has given Dr. Martinez plenty of work over the years! 😂 He is a very spoiled dog who has gotten himself into more than a few mischievous situations, and through all of them, Dr. Martinez has always been there for us.

Most recently, Coco needed surgery, and it was a very stressful and scary situation for me. Dr. Martinez was not originally able to perform the surgery that same day, but when he realized that Coco truly needed it and that it was an emergency, he somehow managed to make it happen. I cannot explain how much that meant to me. When your pet is part of your family, seeing someone go out of their way to help them when they need it most is something you never forget.

The surgery went extremely well, and once again Dr. Martinez reminded me why, after all these years, I continue to trust him with my pets. He is knowledgeable and professional, but just as importantly, he treats both you and your pet with genuine care and compassion.

And I have to recognize his wonderful staff as well. From the moment you walk through the door, you are treated with warmth and kindness. I was extremely nervous about Coco, and instead of making me feel like I was overreacting, they helped calm me down and made me feel that Coco was in good hands.

A very special thank-you to Lily at the front desk and the wonderful blonde young lady who is always there helping her—I am embarrassed that I can never remember her name! 😂 Both of you are amazing. You are always so warm, patient, welcoming, and caring, not only with the pets but with the people who love them too. That makes such a difference, especially when someone walks into a veterinary clinic scared or worried about their baby.

After approximately 10 years of experiences with Dr. Martinez, from surgeries years ago to all of Coco’s adventures and now his recent emergency surgery, I can say that my trust in him comes from years of seeing how he treats animals and the people who love them.

Dr. Martinez, thank you for everything you have done for my pets over the years and especially for taking care of Coco when he needed you most. Thank you to your entire staff for the compassion, patience, professionalism, and kindness you show every time we walk through your doors.

Coco may be spoiled and mischievous, but I know he is in some of the best hands possible when he is with all of you. ❤️🐾

From the bottom of my heart, thank you. You have earned my trust over 10 years, and I would recommend Dr. Alexander Martinez and his team without hesitation.
Best vet ever and the staff is amazing . Kudos  to the girls in the front desk
I'm only speaking for my friend she takes here dog to Aardvark and I picked up dog food. She does say she trust the vets there and that prices are fair.
I love the clinic and the staff, you’re amazing guys, keep like that.. ❤️❤️🫶🫶 …
The Best Veterinarian in Miami.

Excellent service, honesty, and genuine love for animals. Our dog was attacked by another dog, and finding Aardvark Animal Clinic was a true blessing. Dr. Martinez was straight to the point, demonstrating that his absolute priority was our dog's health and well-being, not our money. They charged a very fair and reasonable fee, gave us the exact medication, and treated us with incredible compassion. It was our first time, and they truly make a difference compared to other veterinary clinics. Thank you to Dr. Martinez and all the staff who work with him. I recommend Aardvark Animal Clinic 100%.

I am very happy with the attention my dog has received. Today, he underwent a dental cleaning with anesthesia. I was  very nervous because I did not know how he would react, but the team of doctors is very good. They did a great job. Thank you very much. I recommend them.
Here's a before and after.
really kind people they helped me a lot for my cat
Excellent service! Pleasant place, attentive secretaries, and a team very committed to their patients' health. They have all the necessary equipment to handle emergencies and make timely diagnoses…

I feel bad because I've been going to this vet for years, but it's illogical to give you an appointment you made well in advance and then make you wait over an hour to be seen. I don't see the point of appointments; we all have obligations, that's why we make the appointment. I couldn't wait any longer and I left. It's a shame. Thanks again.

I cannot say enough good things about Dr Martinez and his staff. He truly is the best and so is every single person that works there. They love animals and want them to be healthy.  I recommend him to everyone that needs a vet!  Best of the best!  Thank you for the excellent care you give Rhino!
Very good service 🐕🐈 …

I will always recommend Aardvark Animal Clinic. The staff are always friendly and listen to any concerns and offer accommodations when possible. The doctors actually listen to any issues your pet may have and communicate very well when explaining any possible issues and why certain services are being rendered, as well of any possible next steps of service. I can absolutely trust that my pets will be taken care of from beginning to end with this amazing group of people.

I brought my cat here his whole life, and he was diagnosed with a heart murmur at this hospital. After he was diagnosed, I brought him in for a simple scratch on his eye and the doctors (knowing about his murmur) gave him steroid shots that caused him to go into HEART FAILURE. When I took him to another doctor for this heart failure, they were appalled*** that a vet would give an animal with a diagnosed heart murmur steroids because it can cause heart failure.

My cat is still alive, but has to be on medicine for the rest of his life, has a lower quality of life, and I have spent thousands in veterinary cardiology bills trying to help my cat after the negligence of this place.

Do not go here if you love your pets.
I've been taking my dog ​​Lucy to them for years and I highly recommend them. The doctors are excellent and the service is very good.

I love this place. the staff, the doctors and the facility are top notch! they care about the animals and the people and have always been fair about pricing. My baby is currently in surgery as we speak and I feel so at peace and confident knowing she is in the best hands. Special shout out to Dr. Martinez and Donna!
Although i lost my little foster puppy they did everything they could very sweet staff
I can’t recommend them enough! Their service, price, and over all cleanliness of the clinic is top tier :)
I took my 4 2 week old kittens and they were handled with excellent care. I could tell they really wanted to help me and them.

I went to this veterinary clinic on a friend's recommendation and I couldn't be happier. It was our first visit and everything was excellent: the place was very clean and the service was amazing. I took my dog ​​in for her registration and vaccinations, and the whole team was so caring and attentive. Dr. Alexander and the staff explained everything clearly and made me feel very at ease. 100% recommended 🐾

Dr Alex Martínez, Darien, Lili and all his staff, are the best! They treat your pet with love and care and answer all your questions. The pricing is reasonable, taking into account,  that medicine amd exams are still pricey. They're clean and on time. Highly recommended!!!

Been going here for nearly 5 yrs and have always had a great experience. Dr. Martinez and staff are awesome, very caring and attentive to your concerns. They are always ready to care for your fur babies, have great hours, and they make room for you for any emergencies. Prices are reasonable and he gives you options for treatment.
Best clinic Ever
The treatment my dog ​​Maila received was very special. They are excellent, from the receptionist to the nurses. And the doctor, Dr. Martinez, is superb. God bless them.
Excellent service. I've only been twice. A bit pricey, though. Thanks.

Karl was having issues with his intestines and ultrasound radiologist said it was gallbladder and when Dr Martinez opened him to perform surgery he saw that the gallbladder was perfect and it was a mass and he removed it successfully and sent to analize and it was cancer .
All the staff at this vet have been very kind, and the last time I took my dog, they treated him very well, the treatment worked, and he improved. I will bring him back.

For 8 years I have been taken my pet and part of the family Sofie  (dog) to Aardvark Clinic and have always received  tip notch service and pricing, the staff are family like, and very friendly, yesterday my wife arrived home yesterday to find Sofie in a pool of blood coming from the paw of her rear hind leg. Dr Mesa at Aardvark examined  and found Sofie had lost a nail causing the blood loss, so Dr Mesa cleaned her up checked all her vitals and ears etc and all was good,  it was so assuring to see Sofie was ok
I highly recommend this animal clinic to anyone and Dr Mesa

thank you Robert L Hubbard Miami Lakes Florida

We are deeply grateful for the exceptional care our dog received during the holiday season. In a moment of urgency and with very little notice, we had to place our complete trust in this team when she needed emergency surgery on Christmas Eve. From the very first contact, everyone treated her with so much love, care, and dedication. Even on the days the clinic was closed, the nurses remained attentive and focused on her recovery. The human and professional quality was outstanding in every area, from reception and billing to the veterinary assistants and the veterinarians themselves. We couldn't have been in better hands during such a difficult time.

My family and I are incredibly grateful for the outstanding care this vet office provided during the holiday season. At the very last minute, we had to place our full trust in them when our dog needed emergency surgery on Christmas Eve. The entire team treated her with so much love, care, and attention. Even on days the clinic was closed, the nurses remained attentive and continued to check on her recovery. The treatment was exceptional across the board—from the receptionist and medical biller to the vet assistants and veterinarians themselves. We truly couldn’t have asked for better care during such a stressful time.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Aardvark Animal Clinic, especially Dr. Salazar. She is nothing short of AMAZING! From the moment we walked in, she treated my cat with so much compassion, patience, and genuine care. You can truly tell she loves what she does and deeply cares about her patients. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

Horrible experience in this office.  The woman that saw us got 2 other people in the room. One man and the other a woman. The older man with 2 earrings didn't know how to take out blood from my dog. He had to bring 2 other men to do it. He poked 2 times into my dogs chest trying to get blood.  So, he finally got 2 other men to take out blood and he was blaming my sick dog that he couldn't get blood out. I was feeling sorry for my dog since it wasn't feeling well.  God Only knows what they did to my dog when the did x-ray.  It's like they All know each other and cousins and friends and families.  Seriously, it's ridiculous. No one there knew anything. They mistreated my dog when they were taking blood out. Can U just imagine how bad they were doing x-ray.  I mean don't hire people that they don't know.  I never meet the doctor I only meet a woman and the people I'm saying on this review.  Most of these people that R saying good things about this place work here. They treated my dog like garbage and the staff acted like the animals in cages. Better said the inmates R running the insane asylum. When they did my dogs x-ray it looked like they separated the legs sooooooo wide that I was in shock.  I mean the woman that saw us started saying your dog is old put her down and like she lived her life already.  Does she want people to say that to her when shes 80 years old.  Ridiculous! Go somewhere else people if U really love ❤️ ur dogs and animals.

This vet refuses to be truthful when you have a pet that is dying you can ask him basic questions and he will just fill you up with optimism and medication/treatments instead of being truthful. My dear pet companion who has since passed was gravely ill and he misdiagnosed my pet with something else. When I learned of my pets true condition I asked how much time do we have? As quality of life is of upmost importance & the vet literally refused to answer the question directly and beat around the bush with the most vague answer essentially “play it by ear”. I know he is not a genie and can’t give a precise day/date but being a medical professional and swing the pet is in decline at least give a semi professional estimate / answer. At the end of the day his business only makes money if he continually sells you treatments. When basic human honesty costs 0.

I can’t recommend this veterinary clinic and Dr. Martinez highly enough! This was our first time here, and it happened during a scary emergency, my 6-year-old Bichon Frise Charlie suddenly had what looked like a cyst burst. Even though we didn’t have an appointment, they took us in immediately. After the initial exam and a follow-up, Dr. Martinez recommended surgery, and I’m so glad we moved forward with it. The surgery was a complete success—they not only fixed the original ruptured cyst but had removed several additional ones that weren’t visible at first. Dr. Martinez is kind, knowledgeable, reassuring, and clearly loves what he does. The staff is wonderful, the clinic is spotless, and the pricing is surprisingly reasonable. I drive 30 minutes each way and it’s absolutely worth it.  I highly recommend this clinic!
They took care of my bebita really well 😊 …
Been going here for years and will continue going here . Friendly staff, affordable, answers questions over the phone, very helpful.

I have been using this vet for over 10 years. I may have left a review already in that time but I feel like its time for an update. This place is still the best and Dr. Martinez is the kindest and most empathetic vet I have ever met. He cares about your pets and he's not looking just to steal money from you. Also all of the staff is fantastic. I saw some reviews about people having to wait and, honestly, it makes me happy not only to see this place thrive enough to be packed, but also to know that pet owners are really taking care of their pet's health. Don't hesitate to come here.
Excellent service, they are always special with my dogs, from the front desk staff, assistants and doctors.

Went with my daughter to take her dog to check on some infections and rashes, and I was extremely impressed with the facility, the staff and the care they provided.  Everyone was caring, compassionate and knowledgeable.  This 35 lb Frenchie is strong and did not like to be there but the staff was patient and handled him well.  I could tell they love what they do.  Gracias AAC.
Excellent service and very humane with the animals.
Excellent service, great care and friendly staff. I had an emergency and they took care of my cat right away. I highly recommend them! Thank you!!!

We had a fantastic experience at this clinic. We arrived with our dog Rocco, who had been vomiting for several days. We had already taken him to another clinic, but the treatment they gave him wasn't helping. Here, Dr. Niuvis Salazar knew what was wrong with him the moment she saw him. They ran several tests before surgery to be sure. Both she and Dr. Martínez took great care of us and explained everything step by step. Thank you so much to the entire team. Everyone was very professional. My husband and I are so grateful to all the staff at this clinic, and especially to Dr. Niuvis. She has hands of gold. Thank you so much on behalf of Rocco. You saved our little guy's life.

I took my dog ​​to this clinic for the first time today. All the staff are very kind and friendly to both the animals and their owners. I'm grateful for everyone's care, especially Dr. Alexander Martínez's. I recommend it 1000%!

They are the best! All staff are very attentive to you and your pet. They explain in great detail and make sure you understand everything before they do any procedure or give any medication to your pet.
Excellent! Professionalism in explaining and treating our baby. Staff is so sweet. Services fee were very reasonable. Thank you!
Best animal clinic!
Best staff and doctors in Hialeah for your pets.

ZERO.
I had an appointment scheduled for 1:30 PM and arrived early at 12:00, hoping to be seen promptly. Instead, the waiting time was nearly three hours while walk-ins were prioritized over scheduled patients. It was completely disorganized.

To make matters worse, the front desk staff were unprofessional and dismissive. There was no clear communication, no apology for the delay, and no effort to manage expectations. It felt like my time - and my pet’s wellbeing - were not valued at all.

I understand emergencies happen, but this was not an isolated incident. If you value punctuality, transparency, and basic courtesy, I would strongly recommend looking elsewhere.

I have been coming to Dr.Martinez since my dog has been a puppy. He is one of the most caring and honest vets I’ve ever met and will forever be grateful for his attention and dedication to animals. I hope to continue having him as our go to vet for as long as we have pets.

This is the best and friendliest clinic I have gone to, My Princess had a medical emergency and they not only saw her without an appointment but also, did her surgery on the same day. The staff was helpful and understood the situation and how special she is to my family. Dr. Alex is always great and Dr. Jose Mesa performed the surgery. I highly recommend this clinic. Another clinic, Doral Centre AH was trying to charge me 5x the amount for the same service without being sure what was wrong with my dog. This clinic reassured me and took really good care of Princess. She is out on the same day. I’m extremely pleased with the set use and grateful. - Annette F

This isn't just a friendly comment; it's heartfelt. I have many pets, and I know every vet in Miami. This team of vets is definitely excellent. Anyone who feels ripped off or hasn't received a coherent response regarding their pet can make a real difference by going to this clinic!

My first time trying out this place and while I can’t say much about the doctor’s expertise, I can say that their lack of respect for customer’s time is ridiculous. Sat there for over an hour in the waiting room and was told I might even have to wait more once I get assigned a room. Mind you, a handful of people kept walking in for their appointments as well, also waiting in the room. I can only imagine how long they have to wait while the office staff kept chatting and laughing together and with the vet assistance who seemed to have no urgency to help or contribute to getting patients served.

I am a Broward Resident and my co-worker referred me to Dr. Martinez. My Baby girl Sassy was ill and pooping blood, this has never happened to my pets, and it all began when i started taking them to a doggie park, anyways i drove 52 minutes and it was so worth it, Dr , Martinez and his staff are absolutely amazing, I was a nervous reck and they not only took care of my sassy and my bliss but they comforted me as well. Moving forward that will be my Paw Babies Doctor, and i will 100% drive 50 minutes because it was absolutely worth it. Gracias Dr. Martinez y su equipo.
Great, attentive staff. Affordable service

Worse services ever, if you don’t wanna waste your money don’t go here. They do a bunch of unnecessary things just to charge you more money. Only monetize with your pet, specially Dr Pacheco . Trust me don’t go there
We have been clients for several years with our dog as a patient. The doctor is very good.
Great service, very professional and everyone was attentive.

The only ones I trust my pets with! They are always helpful, they were the ones who helped me with my belated dog and found out there was something wrong with her and they gave me referrals for specialists. The prices are reasonable too.
Good service and attention, and good prices.

It was truly surprising how much humanity and care they showed their customers. I am deeply grateful for the warmth and kindness with which they treated us. Not even in a hospital did I receive such support and understanding in the face of loss. Thank you so much.

I can't say enough good things about Aardvark Animal Clinic! The staff here is absolutely excellent—everyone is so caring and loving with our fur babies. It’s clear they genuinely love animals, and it shows in the way they treat our pets. Dr. Martinez is fantastic—professional, knowledgeable, and always takes the time to answer all of our questions with patience and care. The entire team goes above and beyond to make sure our pets are well taken care of. We truly appreciate their kindness and attention to detail. Highly recommend Aardvark Animal Clinic for anyone looking for a compassionate and skilled veterinary team. A solid 5-star experience every time!
Good vet and good prices ❤️❤️❤️

They made me wait 3 hours with a sick dog. I notified the receptionist that the animal was vomiting and in pain. She told me to arrive before 12 pm, but we weren't seen until 3 pm. From there, they sent us to a hospital because they didn't have the special ultrasound equipment. My dog ​​died Saturday at a veterinary hospital in Byscayne, Boulder. I will never take an animal there again.

I absolutely do not recommend this place. The staff is incredibly rude and they don't care about your pet; they only care about getting paid. The treatment of my pet was awful. I waited for over four hours with my sick pet, and they didn't care at all about his health. They are terrible. Don't bring your pet to this hellhole called a veterinary clinic. All they want is to steal money from pet owners; they don't care about the animals' well-being.

Really good customer service and prices. You can really tell that the veterinarians here have one mission only and that is to make sure your pet stays healthy, without having predatory prices. Amazing people.

My dog just had surgery with Dr Martinez, and i couldnt be happier! Thankfully my dog recovered perfectly, the surgery went amazing!!! Dr Martinez and staff are just incredible, he is an excellent human being that cares deeply for animals. I recommend this vet clinic to anyone who has a pet! I will always take my pets to this clinic, very satisfied customer/ pet patient. I wish there was more than 5 stars, they truly deserve more than 5!

I’d advise anyone that has a sick pet or a pet in need of serious medical attention to NOT come here !
These people are absolutely disgusting, rude and they have no compassion for others whatsoever . I came here to put my baby down. The back staff and tech were completely disrespectful, cursing, screaming and laughing near our door and speaking badly about our situation. No remorse or care in the world knowing that the clinic was full of other clients. Something I’ve never experienced before. I wasn’t able to hold my baby while she was being layed to rest even though she was sedated basically sleeping. The doctor did not go over what he was doing. He did not explain the process so I was completely in the dark. He looked lost and did not know how to speak to us going through this process. As an example the doctor placed the stethoscope upside-down on her chest to confirm she was gone  and noticed shortly after and flipped it to the correct side. I would never trust any other pet to be in their care. Only the front desk staff were helpful and very sweet. Only reason this place is still standing has to go to their front desk staff. Gilly is an angel as well as the office manager.
Excellent service and very good prices, the best and most affordable of all the veterinary clinics I've visited.
I have been using this vet for 27 yrs. Do not give parvo vax if your dog is over 7 years, not going to dog park, or boarding. Can render them blind, limited hearing, and blindness.

This is the best vet clinic I've ever taken My pets. The staff is great they are helpful,kind and knowledgeable, I bring both of my dogs here. Doctor Alex is amazing and always helpful. I would definitely recommend this vet to anyone who wants to take care of their pet.

If I could give a thousand stars I would, if I could give an infinite amount of stars I would. This clinic, this team, Dr. Martinez, they’re all such a wonderful group of people. I have 3 cats and it’s always a great visit! In fact today I took all 3 for their wellness visit and one of my cats needed an xray and she came back PURRING!!! That alone says how amazing they are, I’m never scared or stressed about taking my fur babies to the vet because I know it’s always going to a good experience for them and for me! 100% recommend to anyone and everyone that has cats or dogs!!

The best animal clinic. Their affection for your pet is unparalleled. The service and attention are all wonderful. They spayed my dog ​​and her recovery went very well; they even called to check on her. Overall, I recommend them 100%.

Great vet. Saved my pup when he had a prostate infection. Had taken him to another pet hospital that charged triple and they were not even able to provide a diagnosis for him. Aardvark was able to get him treated in time and he had a full recovery. Recommend this place to everyone. And they were all super nice.

I took my cat there for her medical check up . the service there is terrible. They’re more concerned about what they can get out of you instead of the quality of treatment. I will never go back there again. I rather pay more elsewhere for the treatment that the service is in par . Don’t recommend that place . Typical Hialeah mentality
It's a wonderful place with excellent professionals and very good service.
